profiles.description: Apply-and-settle time and allocations of sparse edits among 1k and 3k live rows, plain and virtual.
Compile/runtime timing plus compiler phase probes.
Runtime parse-queue module boundaries for worker distribution and overlap analysis.
Runtime allocation count and byte metrics from the benchmark metrics sidecar.
Process footprint at exit, with its peak and its GPU, malloc and collector parts, for settled windows and for collector page return.
Temporary-root shim time, operation volume, nesting depth, and storage growth.

Equivalent no-GC, never-collect, and normal runs with GC latency, CPU, memory, lock, assist, barrier, and tax metrics. Variant run times, CPU times, context switches, instructions, cycles, and tax ratios are warm-launch medians from brix-bench-run; results saved before 2026-10-22 timed one cold launch and are a different series.
Grammar probe counters across the full benchmark selection.
Runtime counters proving String iterator work, cursor progress, and checksums.
Combined runtime and compiler capture-frame attribution counters.
Graphics stdlib probe counters across the benchmark selection.
Vector document snapshot, restore, replay, and derived-geometry sync timings recorded as benchmark probe counters.
Timing and rate metrics for interactive graphics update workloads.
TUI mutation, layout, paint, and markup probe counters across the benchmark selection.
Timing and rate metrics for interactive TUI update workloads.
Markup/style runtime counters and allocation metrics for synthetic update workloads.
Event reference-lowering counters and allocation metrics.
Input/checkpoint/style/layout/paint percentiles plus TUI and allocation metrics.
GUI frame path, memory slope, text layout, virtual windowing, and walk-visit probe counters across the benchmark selection.
GUI stdlib frame-path probes compiled in, with bench walk counters for cross-checking.
Retained GUI display-scene timing, allocation, damage, and hierarchy evidence.
Metal packet, window presentation, batching, GPU, parity, allocation, damage, and idle evidence.
Chat archive full-text search timings over synthetic archives of 5,000 and 20,000 chats, recorded as benchmark probe counters.
